$comment: Request manifest per surface × state (performance rubric G1), approved 2026-11-04 (rubric amendments v2.2, ruling 2) as both round 1 reviewers agreed after cross-critique: 186 needed, 60 merge, 30 defer, 2 should-not-happen, 6 split, from the cross-critique's final table (rounds/perf-r1/codex/critique-work/manifest-final-decisions.tsv, SHA-256 in docs/proposals/performance-manifest-follow-ups.md). `review` is the table's P-id. The should-not-happen new-draft authoring/preview has no entry. Split entries: the in-view identities at route-ready decide needed (data) from prefetch. Every merge/defer entry names its followUp in docs/proposals/performance-manifest-follow-ups.md. Replaces the B-seeded manifest; the 2026-11-03 proposal is tools/perf/history/manifests-proposed-2026-11-03.json.
